detail.title: Display using various adhesive and electronic device including the same
detail.abstract: According to various embodiments, a display and an electronic device including the same are provided. The display includes a first layer comprising a first member, a second layer comprising a second member formed below the first layer, a first adhesive member formed in the first region of a third layer between the first layer and the second layer and having a first property, and a second adhesive member formed in the second region of the third layer and having a second property. The characteristic of the adhesive member for bonding respective members is configured to be different according to each region so as to have excellent deformation characteristics and to realize excellent durability due to external impact. Various other embodiments are possible.
